points.why: Explicitly names the 'success to the successful' loop.
Explains that students produce papers that earn stipends, so the outcome records allocation history and headcount rather than quality.
Recommends changing the rule: a per-group floor, per-capita measures, multi-year averages, or rotating stipends.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects treating raw output as proof of merit.
Never calls it Escalation and correctly frames it as a shared-resource compounding loop.
